reviews.summary: ICNT faces a scheduled Nov. 3 token unlock within hours of the snapshot, adding material near-term supply/vesting risk during a risk-off BTC regime.
materialRisks: A scheduled Nov. 3, 2026 ICNT unlock is imminent; trackers estimate roughly 19.5–19.7M ICNT, about 2.8% of total supply, distributed partly to team, investors and other project-linked allocations. ([coingecko.com](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/impossible-cloud-network-token?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: ICNT identifies as Impossible Cloud Network’s native token; the ICNT-EUR market identity is consistent with the Kraken ICNT/EUR listing. ([docs.icn.global](https://docs.icn.global/icn-economics/tokenomics/the-icnt?utm_source=openai))

CoinGecko lists the unlock as about 10 hours away, releasing 19.46M ICNT; its allocation details include 6.53M team and 6.4M investor tokens. ([coingecko.com](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/impossible-cloud-network-token?utm_source=openai))

An independent unlock tracker estimates 19.68M ICNT on Nov. 3, or 2.81% of circulating supply, directed to investors, insiders and community allocations. ([terminalnox.com](https://terminalnox.com/unlocks/ICNT?utm_source=openai))

No security incident in the prior 90 days was reported by CertiK’s project page; this does not negate the immediate supply-event risk. ([skynet.certik.com](https://skynet.certik.com/projects/impossible-cloud-network?utm_source=openai))
